title: 3M-CPSEED：An EEG-based Dataset for Chinese Pinyin Production in Overt, Silent-intended, and Imagined Speech
description: 3M-CPSEED is an EEG dataset capturing brain activity from 20 healthy native Chinese speakers performing overt, silent-intended, and imagined speech production of Chinese Pinyin syllables. The dataset targets speech neurophysiology research, particularly the neural correlates of pinyin articulation across speech modes, and supports transfer learning studies for other alphabetic languages.
methods_description: EEG was recorded from 20 healthy, right-handed native Chinese speakers (mean age 24.55, SD 2.58; 11 females, 9 males) while they read displayed Pinyin syllables (finals: a, i, u, ü; initials: m, f, j, l, k, ch) under three conditions: overt speech, silently articulated speech, and imagined speech. Each participant completed 4 blocks of 1600 trials.
